title: Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains
abstract: arXiv:2610.40091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. translated_title: 面向多个专业化领域的语言模型升级方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的有效多领域适应需要在优先利用相关领域知识的同时，尽量减少来自无关领域的干扰。现有方法通常使用低秩适配为每个领域训练一个单独的适配器，并将这些适配器组合到一个模型中。然而，这些方法要么不区分输入领域而给所有适配器赋予相同权重，要么虽然动态加权适配器，但仍然会激活包括无关领域在内的所有适配器。此外，尽管低秩结构高效，但其性能受到限制。相比之下，升级是一种模型扩展方法，它在稠密Transformer层中添加专家模块和路由器，能够提供比LoRA方法更大的容量。在本文中，我们提出了用于多领域适应的领域专业化升级。我们引入了一种新的领域感知监督机制，使路由器能够通过选择合适的专家来有效学习区分不同领域。
tldr: 提出领域专业化升级方法，通过领域感知监督机制训练路由器选择合适的专家以区分不同领域，相比LoRA方法具有更大容量，并在避免无关领域干扰的同时实现大语言模型的多领域适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling), which introduces domain-aware supervision to train a router to select appropriate experts for distinguishing domains, offering larger capacity than LoRA-based approaches while enabling effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models.
